description:
Status Saver - Status Downloader – Fast & Easy Status Saving

Looking for the best way to save status, download status, and repost status in seconds? 🚀 Status Saver - Status Downloader is the app to quickly save and download status photos & videos in HD quality.

🔥 Key Features

  Status Saver – Save photos & videos from status updates in original quality.
  Status Downloader – One-tap status download for quick and easy saving.
  Repost Status – Share saved statuses directly without downloading twice.
  Built-in Video Player – Watch videos & view images inside the app.
  Offline Access – View saved statuses anytime, even without internet.
  Fast & Lightweight – Small app size and smooth performance.
  User-Friendly Design – Simple and intuitive interface for everyone.


📲 How to Use

  Open your chat app & view the status you like.
  Return to Status Saver - Status Downloader and tap Download.
  Your status is instantly saved to your gallery – ready to view or share!


📥 Save & Download Status in One Tap  
No more screenshots or asking friends to share. Just open the app, tap download, and your status is saved instantly.

🎥 Photo & Video Downloads  
Download photos and videos in original resolution with no quality loss.

🔄 Repost Instantly  
Love a status? Repost or share it directly from the app with a single click.

📂 Organize Your Saved Statuses  
All saved statuses are stored in one place so you can easily view, watch, or share them anytime.

💡 Why Choose Status Saver - Status Downloader?

  Fast & easy to use
  No login required
  Supports both photos & videos


📥 Download now & start saving your favorite statuses today!
